summary: Lower & through JavaScript bitwise semantics instead of directly using arbitrary C# integer operators.

target.notes: Number operands use ECMAScript ToInt32/ToUint32 and shift-count masking rules; BigInt uses BigInt bitwise semantics where supported. Mixing Number and BigInt throws TypeError.

semantics.coercion: ToNumeric; Number narrowed according to operator-specific ToInt32/ToUint32
semantics.result_type: Number or BigInt except >>> on BigInt throws

caveats: JavaScript >>> returns an unsigned 32-bit value represented as Number and is not defined for BigInt.
Direct C# int operations can lose the JavaScript result range/boxing semantics.
